dialogues.en:
I used to think that I wanted to spend all day in bed.
Moreover, I used to think I wanted to hibernate like an
animal.
dialogues.text:
I used to think that I wanted to spend all day in bed.
Moreover, I used to think I wanted to hibernate like an
animal.

dialogues.en: However, I never asked anybody to force me to sleep!
dialogues.text: However, I never asked anybody to force me to sleep!

dialogues.jp: 呟いた言葉が、誰もいない病室に吸い込まれる。
dialogues.en:
"......I think I was thinking the same thing just a few
minutes ago......"
dialogues.text:
"......I think I was thinking the same thing just a few
minutes ago......"

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩が帰ってしまうと、途端に何もすること
がなくなってしまう。
dialogues.en: "I'm bored."
dialogues.text: "I'm bored."

dialogues.jp:
確かに一日中、寝て過ごしたいと思ったことも、
無いとは言わない。それどころか、冬眠したい
と思ったことだってあったさ。
dialogues.en:
I have some manga that Moe got me, but I don't feel like
reading them in the daylight.
dialogues.text:
I have some manga that Moe got me, but I don't feel like
reading them in the daylight.

dialogues.jp:
だが、無理矢理、寝かせて欲しいなんて思った
ことは一度もないぞ！
dialogues.en: I wish I had some games......
dialogues.text: I wish I had some games......

dialogues.jp:
「……なんか、少し前も同じこと考えていた気
　がする」
dialogues.en: Knock, knock......
dialogues.text: Knock, knock......

dialogues.jp: 「つまらん」
dialogues.en: "? Come in."
dialogues.text: "? Come in."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩の買って来てくれた雑誌があると言えば
あるが、何だかんだ言ってもう全部読んでしまっ
たし……。
dialogues.en: Is it Mako this time?
dialogues.text: Is it Mako this time?

dialogues.jp: せめて、ゲームとかがあれば……。
dialogues.en:
No matter who it is, they're welcome. I don't care if it's
an angel or a devil as long as they can save me from this
boredom.
dialogues.text:
No matter who it is, they're welcome. I don't care if it's
an angel or a devil as long as they can save me from this
boredom.

dialogues.jp: コンコン――
dialogues.en: Click......
dialogues.text: Click......

dialogues.jp: 「？　どうぞ」
dialogues.en: The door opened, and the angel came into the room......
dialogues.text: The door opened, and the angel came into the room......

dialogues.jp: また、眞子でも来たのだろうか？
dialogues.en: "Hey, you look good, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Hey, you look good, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
とにかく今は誰であれ大歓迎だ。この暇な時間
を終わらせてくれるなら、悪魔だって天使と認
めよう。
ガチャ――
dialogues.en: It was a devil who came into the room......
dialogues.text: It was a devil who came into the room......

dialogues.jp: ドアが開き、やって来た天使が姿を見せる。
dialogues.en: "I wish I could go back to being bored......"
dialogues.text: "I wish I could go back to being bored......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お、元気そうだな朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Huh? What is it?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "No, it's nothing."
dialogues.text: "No, it's nothing."

dialogues.jp: やって来たのは、唯一例外の悪魔だった。
dialogues.en: People's desires can change in a moment.
dialogues.text: People's desires can change in a moment.

dialogues.jp: 「さっきまでの時間が懐かしい……」
dialogues.en: "So what are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "So what are you doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　何がだ？」
dialogues.en:
"I came to check on you, of course. What else would I be
here for?"
dialogues.text:
"I came to check on you, of course. What else would I be
here for?"

dialogues.jp: 人間の欲望など、変わりやすいものだ。
dialogues.en: He spoke with confidence and showed me the bag he brought.
dialogues.text: He spoke with confidence and showed me the bag he brought.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「もちろん、見舞いだ。この状況で、それ以外
　に何が考えられる」
dialogues.en: "I also brought you a get well gift."
dialogues.text: "I also brought you a get well gift."

dialogues.jp:
自信たっぷりに告げた杉並が、持ってきた鞄を
俺に見せる。
dialogues.en: "Wow! That's my friend!"
dialogues.text: "Wow! That's my friend!"

dialogues.jp: これで、退屈な時間から開放される。
dialogues.en: I'm finally getting away from the boredom.
dialogues.text: I'm finally getting away from the boredom.

dialogues.jp: 「で、どんなものを持ってきたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "So what did you bring for me?"
dialogues.text: "So what did you bring for me?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふふふ……見ろ」
dialogues.en: "Hehehe...... look."
dialogues.text: "Hehehe...... look."

dialogues.jp:
杉並がバッグの口を開く。俺は上体を起こし、
その中を覗き込む……。
dialogues.en:
Suginami opened the bag. I raised my body up, and looked
inside of the bag......
dialogues.text:
Suginami opened the bag. I raised my body up, and looked
inside of the bag......

dialogues.jp:
そこには、杉並みの愛読書『ヌー』がずらりと
並べられていた。
dialogues.en:
There were no games in the bag. Instead, it was filled with
a rope, a bottle of some chemical, and self-defense items.
dialogues.text:
There were no games in the bag. Instead, it was filled with
a rope, a bottle of some chemical, and self-defense items.

dialogues.jp: 「……ひとつ｛き／訊｝くが何だ、これは？」
dialogues.en: "......What the heck are these?"
dialogues.text: "......What the heck are these?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふっ……お前に、未来の未知に対応する術を
　教えてやろうとおもってな」
dialogues.en:
"Huh...... Something you'll need when you see the nurse
tonight."
dialogues.text:
"Huh...... Something you'll need when you see the nurse
tonight."

dialogues.jp: 俺はベッドに横になると、布団を掛けなおす。
dialogues.en:
I lay back on the bed and covered myself with a blanket
again.
dialogues.text:
I lay back on the bed and covered myself with a blanket
again.

dialogues.jp: 「次は花束にしてくれ。その方がまだ嬉しい」
dialogues.en:
"Would you bring some flowers next time? That'll be a better
choice for me."
dialogues.text:
"Would you bring some flowers next time? That'll be a better
choice for me."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.jp: 杉並がバッグの口を閉める。
dialogues.en: Suginami closed his bag.
dialogues.text: Suginami closed his bag.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「では、次はアイビーの花束を持ってくるとし
　よう。花言葉は“友情”“死んでも離れない”
　“永遠の愛”」
dialogues.en:
"Then I'll bring you an ivy bouquet next time. Ivy's for
'friendship', 'Never separate after death', and 'Everlasting
love'."
dialogues.text:
"Then I'll bring you an ivy bouquet next time. Ivy's for
'friendship', 'Never separate after death', and 'Everlasting
love'."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……好きにしてくれ」
dialogues.en: "......Do whatever you like."
dialogues.text: "......Do whatever you like."

dialogues.jp:
布団を引き寄せ、頭からかぶる。暖かな布団の
中で、なぜか寒気がした。
dialogues.en:
I pulled the blanket and covered my head. For some reason, I
felt a chill inside of the warm blanket.
dialogues.text:
I pulled the blanket and covered my head. For some reason, I
felt a chill inside of the warm blanket.

dialogues.jp: ◆花言葉◆

病室で暇にしていると、杉並が現れた。殊勝な
ことに、暇つぶしになるものを持ってきたと言
う。

だがそれは、｛おびただ／夥｝しい量の雑誌『ヌー』だった。
俺はそんなものより、まだ花の方がマシだと伝
えると――
dialogues.en: "I'm bored......"
dialogues.text: "I'm bored......"

dialogues.jp:
次はアイビーの花束を持ってくるという。花言
葉は、友情、死んでも離れない、永遠の愛。
dialogues.en: My words were sucked into the empty room.
dialogues.text: My words were sucked into the empty room.

dialogues.en: There was nothing to do after Moe left the room.
dialogues.text: There was nothing to do after Moe left the room.
